messages:
sam: Quick q — proposing a 'smart filter' default chain for the Console per-route pages: 1) route-specific saved query, 2) model-specific saved query, 3) org default. Also need to bake in routing/quotas so we don't default to a high-cost model when a route is quota-constrained. Thoughts?

maria: +1 to the fallback chain. UX note: surface the source of the default (badge/pill) and show a tiny cost estimate next to it. If the default picks a heavy model, show a subtle warning and a one-click 'use conservative variant'.

kevin: Implementation note: the routing/policy service already returns candidate models + rough cost/unit estimates. We can add metadata to saved queries: `preferred_model` and `estimated_units_per_request`. Backend will need to resolve final default by combining saved-query hints and routing policy. We'll want a cache with TTL ~60s for lookups.

devin: UX mock idea: in the header show "Default: route / model / org" (compact selector). Hover reveals why we picked it and a `Preview cost` link. Keyboard shortcut to cycle defaults would be handy for power users. I'll sketch a prototype.

iris: Telemetry concerns: we need to track per-default impressions and quality signals. Suggest an initial sampling strategy: 100% telemetry capture for first 5k impressions for a given default, then ramp to 1% for long tail. Also wire in eval sets so we can detect regressions when a model-default changes.

sam: Rollout plan proposal: canary 10% of routes for 48h -> evaluate error_rate and cost_delta -> promote to 100% if error_rate < 0.5% and cost_delta < +15%. How do we expose rollout state in the UI so PMs/Eng can monitor?

maria: Show 'rollout status' on saved-query detail: current canary %, errors (last 24h), cost delta, and a pause button. Should be visible to owners and ops.

kevin: I'll add an endpoint: `GET /api/savedquery/{id}/rollout_status` that returns (status, canary_pct, cost_delta, error_rate). We'll gate by project auth. Backend will also emit a telemetry event when canary changes.

devin: Add an inline CTA: 'Revert to org default' with a small confirmation modal: "Switching back resets route override". Also show an audit link to view who changed the default and when.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled canary rollout for smart-defaults at 1742130200 (48h). :rocket:

sam: Thanks all. Follow-ups: @devin prototype the header selector, @kevin add the rollout endpoint + cache, @iris configure sampling & evals. I'll track as a task on the product board and loop in support for any edge-case docs.
